prediction_text: Direction: Donald Trump wins. Prediction: The panel astrologer who had earlier picked Trump as the Republican nominee when 17 Republicans still contested it will again be on Trump — Donald Trump defeats Hillary Clinton and wins the 2016 US presidential election, against the poll consensus. Timing window: decided 8 November 2016, main coordinate election day 8 November 2016.
basis:
tradition=western-election-astrology
systems_used=western astrology: individual panel forecaster
依据：Input setting distinguishes this case from the panel consensus: the one astrologer singled out had already made the contrarian Trump-as-nominee call early in the cycle; a forecaster holding that position is read as carrying it through to a Trump general-election win. No chart is supplied in the input card, confidence moderated accordingly.
